title: Working Moms in Real Estate – Special Guest Nicole and a Mother’s Day Memorable Experience Special
description:
🎙️ Welcome Back to Working Moms in Real Estate – Special Guest Nicole and a Mother’s Day Memorable Experience Special! 🎙️

In this heartfelt episode, we’re celebrating all the incredible moms out there with a very special guest—our amazing friend and fellow working mom, Nicole James! 💐 Nicole shares her inspiring journey as a mom of four, a successful real estate lender, and how she balances career, motherhood, and marriage with grace and humor.

👩‍👧‍👦 In This Episode:
Nicole’s powerful story of early motherhood and finding success in the financial industry
Honest conversations about juggling a busy family life and career
Our most Memorable Mother’s Day Experiences—from hilarious mom fails to unforgettable moments that touched our hearts
Beauty hacks and time-saving tips for busy moms 💄
How faith, family, and finding your village make all the difference

This week’s topic is about Mother’s Day Memorable Experiences—How We Celebrate, Our Favorite Memories, and Why Moms Deserve to Be Honored Every Day!

💬 Have Questions or Want to Be a Guest on the Show?
 We’d love to connect! Whether you’re a working mom, in the real estate industry, or just need a little inspiration, we’re here to support you—especially with all your real estate needs.
